title: Voltage across R2
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the voltage across resistor R2 as 10 V using Ohm's law and the total circuit current.

title: Charge on sphere
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the charge on the small sphere as 3.0 × 10⁻⁴ C from the equilibrium of electric and gravitational forces.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the ball's acceleration as 12.5 m/s² immediately after the string is cut.

title: Circuit current calculation
description: Important: Applies Ohm's law for a closed circuit to find the total current using the EMF and all resistances.

title: Capacitor field strength
description: Important: Relates the voltage across R2 to the electric field between the capacitor plates using E = U/d.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Sets up the static equilibrium condition (tan37° = qE/(mg)) for the charged ball.

title: Net force after cut
description: Important: Correctly identifies that after the string is cut, the net force is the vector sum of gravity and the electric force, with magnitude mg/cos37°.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the charge, misidentifies force directions, or incorrectly assumes equilibrium persists after the cut.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (V, C, m/s²) throughout the calculations and includes them in final answers.
